spec074_tab2_inferred_gaps_populated.headline: 9/17 head-landmark density bias (52.9%) hijacks global least-squares grids and degrades whole-body outlines
spec074_tab2_inferred_gaps_populated.statement: Fitting a global coordinate transformation to standard 17-landmark reef-fish wireframes (where 9/17 landmarks sit in the head with scaling exponent b_head=2.0 vs. b_body=3.0) actively degrades whole-body outline overlap (mean IoU drops from 0.614 unwarped to 0.562), whereas direct 600-semilandmark outline fitting recovers 100% of interfamily pairs (mean IoU 0.760).

spec074_tab2_inferred_gaps_populated.headline: Single-grid 17-landmark invariance breaks at the tau* = 48.6 Myr craniofacial-vs-body modularity horizon
spec074_tab2_inferred_gaps_populated.statement: Across held-out phylogenetic divergences, a single global 17-landmark transformation holds within intrageneric disparity (<= 0.0110) on 100% of pairs below tau* = 48.6 Myr, but drops to 0.0% above 50 Myr because sympatric trophic competition accelerates craniofacial/jaw divergence 4.754x faster than axial body-wall divergence.
